items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: We bought the first arrangement Tad Dameron ever wrote

ctx.x: We bought the first arrangement Tad Dameron ever wrote, when he wrote -- when I was with Earl Hines. He's from Cleveland, Ohio, and he was in high school. He was just getting ready to finish high school and he made the arrangement on 'Sweet Georgia Brown.' Well, the reason we

could buy this arrangement was because we had a little thing going in the band, the sax section. Everybody that made a mistake got to pay five cents, or everybody in the brass -- trombone section made a mistake had to pay five cents. Everybody in the trumpet section had to pay five cents. So this money, we would accumulate this money so we could buy our whiskey.
